# `state/sim/WorldDynamics.js`

> **Source:** `engine/state/sim/WorldDynamics.js`

state/sim/WorldDynamics.js — deterministic stepped world dynamics over simulation time (spec §17 CPU deterministic core, rules 66/68 deterministic replay).  World dynamics advance simulated state one tick at a time. To keep canonical state reproducible (and replayable for verification), any randomness comes from a SEEDED deterministic PRNG — never Math.random or wall-clock. Running the same dynamics from the same seed and inputs always yields byte-identical results, which deterministic replay and fault-injection testing depend on.
